name: You Will Have to Move Me

system.flavor:
Block a doorway, a bridge, or a road and make it clear nothing short of force is getting you out of it. Officials argue, a crowd grumbles, one determined man loses his nerve trying. He is too busy with you to bother your friends.

Not enough to stop a mounted rider or a crowd that has decided to go through you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn. Independently, you gain +1 Fortitude and reduce the next Damage from that target by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions against your allies until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Vow
rider.html: Vow: do not voluntarily leave your current space before your next turn. Spend this Authority when the target damages you to make yourself Rallied; leaving first discards it.
